Papers 0.4.0

  • Optional document information below grid thumbnails: titles, localized dates, and independently selectable document type, correspondent, and tag pills. Enable these in Settings → General.
  • Tag pills match Paperless-ngx colors. Long names truncate and additional tags use a compact +N count. Metadata remains available offline.
  • Smooth, interruptible animations when showing or hiding document information, with support for macOS Reduce Motion.
  • Scroll vertically and horizontally with a trackpad after pinching to zoom into a document.
  • Removed bottom notification and progress overlays. Transfer status and cancellation remain available in Transfers.
  • Cleaner application menus without unnecessary trailing ellipses.

Metadata refreshes on launch, every 10 minutes, and with ⌘R. Empty or unassigned values stay hidden.

Papers 0.3.1

  • Pinch to zoom into an open document, up to 4× its fitted size. Zoom out again at fitted size to return to the grid.
  • Drag documents directly into Mail, Finder, and other apps that accept files, without an attachment picker.
  • Drag any selected document to copy the entire selection as separate files. A count badge identifies bulk drags, and duplicate filenames are kept distinct.
  • Improved quick-drag handling, file lifetime, and cancellation. Failed preparation never silently sends only part of a selection.

Files that are not cached download while preparing the drag. If you release before they are ready, Papers asks you to drag the selection again.

Papers 0.3.0

  • Pinch the trackpad to adjust document size smoothly. Command-scroll and remembered grid size continue to work.
  • Select multiple documents with Command-click, Shift-click, Shift-arrow, or Command-A in the grid. Rotate, export, or delete the selection together.
  • Rotate repeatedly while earlier turns sync: previews respond immediately, requests stay ordered per document, and rejected turns are corrected without losing newer actions. Rotation status and cancellation stay in Transfers.
  • Export and delete selections with individual outcomes and cancellation. Bulk export preserves existing files and handles duplicate names.
  • Native search now remembers recent committed queries for each connection, with a Clear action, readable selection colors in light and dark appearance, and a native mask shared by the rounded material and shadow.
  • Command-A in search selects query text. Destructive confirmation uses the native red Delete button, and Escape cancels.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 12 or later. Existing connections and local caches remain in place.

More reliable document menus

Fixes a crash when opening a document's context menu on macOS versions before 27, including macOS 26.6.2.

The menu retains its native icons and actions. This update also strengthens build checks for compatibility with supported macOS versions.

Updates, built into Papers

  • Check for new versions from the Papers menu or General Settings using native macOS update dialogs.
  • Choose daily automatic checks and optionally download updates to install when Papers quits.
  • Requested update restarts wait for active imports, document changes, and transfers to finish.

Your connection settings and local document cache remain in place when Papers updates.
